integrations.uploadTokenDescription: Used by ShareX and the upload scripts. It can only upload files and shorten links, but keep it private.
integrations.regenerateDescription: Configs and scripts that use the current token will stop working.
integrations.uploadOptionsDescription: Applied to every config and script you download below.

sharex.description: A custom uploader for ShareX on Windows.
sharex.import: Download the config and open it. ShareX imports it as a custom uploader.
sharex.destinations: In ShareX, set Destinations → Image, Text and File uploader to Custom uploader.

shortener.name: ShareX URL shortener
shortener.description: Shortens links from ShareX with your short links.
shortener.import: Download the config and open it. ShareX imports it as a custom URL shortener.
shortener.destinations: In ShareX, set Destinations → URL shortener to Custom URL shortener.

script.description: A shell script that uploads a screenshot or files and copies the link.

steps.link: Run it with --link and a URL to shorten the link.
steps.chmod: Download the script and make it executable with chmod +x fileship.sh.
steps.run: Run it without arguments to capture a region, or pass files to upload them.
steps.macosShortcut: For a keyboard shortcut, run it from a Shortcuts "Run Shell Script" action and allow screen recording when asked.
steps.linuxInstall: Install curl, a screenshot tool (grim and slurp, flameshot, maim, gnome-screenshot or spectacle) and wl-clipboard or xclip.
steps.linuxRun: Run it without arguments to capture a region, or pass files to upload them. Bind it to a shortcut in your desktop settings.
